name: ibis Styles Chiang Mai
short_description: A 208-room hotel at the Huay Kaew Road junction, a 10-minute walk from MAYA Shopping Mall, with an infinity pool framed by mountain views.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Chiang Mai sits at a major junction on Huay Kaew Road, running from the moat's northwest corner up to Chiang Mai University, about a 10-minute stroll from MAYA Shopping Mall and Nimman Road. The 208 rooms come with contemporary design, and the hotel's infinity pool has a mountain-view backdrop. Guests consistently praise the comfortable beds, strong shower pressure, and varied Thai/Western breakfast, though a subset report noise from nearby traffic and passing aircraft.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Chiang Mai close to Nimman Road?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's about a 10-minute walk from both MAYA Shopping Mall and Nimman Road, at the Huay Kaew Road junction near Chiang Mai University.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Chiang Mai have a pool with a view?
faqs.answer: Yes -- an infinity pool with a mountain-view backdrop is one of the hotel's standout features, alongside a wide Thai and Western breakfast selection.
